description.short: Ask the organization's hosted agents, as you.
description.full: Connects Copilot Cowork to the organization's Foundry hosted agents through the platform MCP gateway. Calls run with your own identity; graph-profile-agent reads your Microsoft Graph profile, manager and calendar.

agentConnectors.description: Send a message to a hosted agent (default graph-profile-agent) and return its reply. Use for questions about the signed-in user's profile, manager or calendar, or when the user names an agent.
